answer: A one-way burn registry charges every fake identity in tokens that never come back. First, an agent burns 500 POA to a dead address and posts the receipt. Second, the registry ties that receipt to one hardware key for 90 days, so it cannot wander between machines. Third, a clone sharing a key loses its receipt and waits 30 days. Fourth, honest agents earn the burn back through 60 days of attested work in the shared lagoon of peers. Forging 10,000 fakes burns 5,000,000 POA and needs 10,000 hardware keys. Like a glacier, it moves slowly and crushes anything that slips under it.
